description: This Java class represents the 'OrderProductPrice' entity, which models the pricing details for a product within an order, including fields for price, special price, validity period, and associations with the related order product.

classes.name: OrderProductPrice
classes.description: Entity class representing product pricing details in an order, with fields for price, special price, and effective dates, mapped to the 'ORDER_PRODUCT_PRICE' database table.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the primary key ID of the price record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the primary key ID of the price record.

methods.name: getDefaultPrice
methods.description: Returns whether this price is the default price.

methods.name: setDefaultPrice
methods.description: Sets whether this price is the default price.

methods.name: getProductPriceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the product price.

methods.name: setProductPriceName
methods.description: Sets the name of the product price.

methods.name: setOrderProduct
methods.description: Associates this price with a specific OrderProduct.

methods.name: getProductPriceCode
methods.description: Returns the code identifying the product price.

methods.name: setProductPriceCode
methods.description: Sets the code identifying the product price.

methods.name: getProductPriceSpecialStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the special pricing period.

methods.name: setProductPriceSpecialStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the special pricing period.

methods.name: getProductPriceSpecialEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the special pricing period.

methods.name: setProductPriceSpecialEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the special pricing period.
